hero.title: Nearby deals. Book. Use. Save.
hero.lead: UNEMDE is a mobile service for local café and restaurant deals. The guest finds a venue on the map, books a slot, and activates the discount on site.

how.h2p: Find a venue on the map or in the list and choose a deal that suits you.
how.h3p: Book the discount you like for a convenient time.
how.h4p: When you arrive at the venue, activate the discount.
how.h6p: The discount is applied. Rate the venue.

biz.title: Counter, calendar, and deals — in one venue app
biz.sub: For cafés, bakeries, and restaurants. Publish the offers guests see in UNEMDE and activate them on site with the scanner.
biz.journeySub: Every venue screen — from sign-in to scanning a guest at the counter.
biz.j1p: Enter your phone number and confirm the code. New venues register through Sign Up.
biz.j2p: Name, photo, address, hours, payments. Deals: 1+1, −30%, coffee 2+1, quantity and terms.
biz.j3p: Pick a day and see the slots: available, or with a guest name and deal title. Who is coming, and when.
biz.j4p: Camera on the guest QR, or enter the code by hand. Activate — the discount runs until it expires.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.sub: Everything you need to know about UNEMDE
faq.moreSub: The team replies within one business day.
faq.a1: UNEMDE is a mobile app for local discounts at cafés, restaurants, and other partner venues. Available on iOS and Android.
faq.a2: Yes. Downloading and using it is free. There is also Premium, with exclusive deals and early access to limited offers.
faq.q3: Which cities is UNEMDE available in?
faq.a3: Currently: Almaty, Konaev. We announce new cities every quarter.
faq.q4: How do I use a deal?
faq.a4: Open the deal in the app, book a slot, then swipe on site or show the QR to staff.
faq.q5: Can I use the same deal more than once?
faq.a5: Most deals have a limit (for example once a week or once per visit). The app shows how many times you can use it and when it resets.
faq.a6: Yes, each deal has a date and time. Save favourites so you don’t miss them.
faq.q7: Are there takeaway or delivery deals?
faq.a7: Some partners offer the discount both on site and for takeaway. Delivery is usually not included in the deal terms.
faq.q8: How do I create an account?
faq.a8: Download UNEMDE, tap Sign up, and confirm your phone number with a code. It takes less than a minute.
faq.q9: How do I delete my account?
faq.a9: Profile → Account details → Delete account. Your data is removed in accordance with GDPR. Help: support@unemde.app.
faq.a10: Premium unlocks exclusive deals, early access to limited offers, and ad-free browsing. The first 3 months are free with the launch offer.
faq.q11: How do I become an UNEMDE partner?
faq.a11: Write via WhatsApp or Telegram on the For venues page. The team replies within 24 hours. No technical setup is required on your side.
faq.q12: Is there a fee to list my venue?
faq.a12: There is no setup fee. Flexible plans with a small commission on activated deals.
faq.q13: How do I see how many guests used a deal?
faq.a13: UNEMDE Business has a scanner, a booking calendar, and stats (total deals, average bill).
